title: RealWeather: Realistic and Scene-Faithful Weather Translation with Driving World Models

output_modality.value: single-view driving video (720p, 50-frame clips; long video generated autoregressively in 101-frame chunks) translated between clear and adverse weather

control_signal.value: input driving video to translate plus a text prompt describing weather type and intensity (rain, snow, fog, mixed); translation direction clear to adverse or reverse

control_mechanism.value: input video latent concatenated channel-wise with the noisy target latent, text prompt via cross-attention in the DiT; Progressive Realism Bootstrapping training and a segmentation-IoU RL reward (Scene-Fidelity RL)

base_model.value: Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B pre-trained world model (flow-matching DiT with 3D VAE); pseudo-clear data from FLUX.2-dev, Video-Depth-Anything, Canny and SAM3 with Cosmos geometry conditioning

datasets.value: Trained on 7,000 adverse-weather and 1,000 clear videos; evaluated on 100 clear and 200 adverse videos from Waymo Open Dataset, nuScenes and an internal dataset

metrics.value: CLIP text-image similarity, CLIP-Consistency, DINO Structure Distance, PickScore, and a Qwen3-VL-based VLM-Realism score

controllability_evidence.value: Table 1 (numbers not in packet): best CC, PS and VR for clear-to-adverse and ties best CS; adverse-to-clear best PS and VR. Some baselines have lower DS via more conservative edits.

closed_loop.value: no; offline video-to-video translation, not interactive with a driving policy

stated_limitations.value: Inference is about 2.5 FPS on 8 B200 GPUs, far from real time; control is by text only with no fine-grained spatial control of weather effects; extreme-condition generalization is open.

notes: Weather-conditioned video translation rather than a scenario generator with trajectory or layout control. Quantitative table values are not in the packet. Packet's pages are an arXiv 2608.02953 listing as given.
